scenes.title: Contract ending
scenes.caption: Your phone contract with Skyline Mobile ends soon.
scenes.say: A letter from Skyline Mobile says your phone contract is ending. Here is what it means, and what you can do.

scenes.title: The date
scenes.caption: Your 24-month contract ends on 5 January 2027.
scenes.say: Your 24-month contract ends on the fifth of January, 2027. After that, the phone is paid off, so it's yours to keep.

scenes.title: Do nothing
scenes.caption: Doing nothing moves you to a plan costing £32 a month.
scenes.say: Do nothing, and you move onto their standard plan. It's thirty-two pounds a month for the same allowance, which is ten pounds more than now.

scenes.title: Three choices
scenes.caption: You can upgrade, go SIM-only, or leave.
scenes.say: You do have choices. You can upgrade to a new phone, go SIM-only and keep yours, or leave for another network.

scenes.title: The prices
scenes.caption: Upgrades from £25 a month. SIM-only from £8 a month.
scenes.say: Upgrades start at twenty-five pounds a month for 24 months. SIM-only starts at eight pounds a month for 12 months, with 30 gigabytes of data.

scenes.title: Leaving
scenes.caption: Text PAC to 65075 to keep your number. Leaving is free.
scenes.say: If you leave, text PAC to 65075 for a free code, and give it to your new network. You keep your number, and there's no charge.

scenes.title: Next step
scenes.caption: Choose in the Skyline app, or call 150 from your mobile.
scenes.say: So don't leave it to chance. Pick your plan in the Skyline app, or call 150 from your mobile, before the contract ends.
